prompts:
Use case: productivity-visual. Create a professional 16:9 pitch deck slide concept for Sachet. White minimalist editorial design but substantial readable content, navy/dark typography, orange accents, fine pale-grey boundaries. No repeated numbered step cards or process boxes. No decorative icons. One central prominent prototype evidence composition with three editorial callouts pointing to specific real UI areas. Use supplied actual screenshot references, preserve their wording and amounts faithfully. Reference1 is genuine two-event timeline; reference2 genuine assessment and action; reference3 full prototype for supporting quote and alert count extracts. Combine focused screenshot crops into ONE coherent central case exhibit, label it "Prototype case view" subtly if needed. This is screenshot-layout concept; don't invent UI states or unsupported metrics. No tiny whole phone screenshot.
Title centered top, equivalent54pt: "Why Sachet?"
Main statement underneath equivalent32pt: "Connected context, visible evidence, and timely guidance for the next financial decision."
Three callouts exact:
"Context across messages"
"Earlier claims and later payment conditions stay connected in one case."
"Evidence the user can inspect"
"Concerns point to quoted material and explain what remains uncertain."
"Updates without repeated alerts"
"New context updates the assessment; an unchanged concern does not create another alert."
Callout headings bold and short paragraphs large readable. Thin orange dotted leader lines from each callout to relevant prototype region. Leaders must avoid crossing text or other leaders.
The prototype case exhibit shows actual timeline two messages (₹48,000 claim then ₹3,000 additional payment), actual pause&verify assessment, supporting evidence quote + Evidence2 reference, and actual alert panel "1 alert across 2 revisions". Don't imply zero alerts, no fake historical dashboard, no fake confidence or accuracy percentages. In supporting quote region preserve sentence "The supplied material does not verify the sender's identity or intent." Take alert panel from full screenshot near above timeline. Keep app icons only where genuinely present in UI.
No extra standalone explanatory line, tagline or orange strip. Footer small: "Sachet · Team ANKOR" left, "Prototype shown with synthetic test material" center, "RAKSHAM · IIT Delhi | Statement 2" right. Keep screenshot elements believable without stylized 3D perspective. Clear differentiation without claims competitors lack these features.
Variant1: CENTRAL HERO. Case exhibit spans central60% width and approximately65% height. It contains timeline left and assessment+supporting quote right; a small genuine alert-count crop sits at its bottom. Outside exhibit, callout1 upperleft margin, callout2 rightmargin middle, callout3 lowerleft margin. Balanced asymmetry, clean whitespace, callout paragraphs wrap in narrow but readable blocks. Thin orange dotted curved leaders. No borders on callouts.
